data.name: Advanced Mind Knight Path
data.description: As long as you have both Mind Knight path powers, you can manifest both Mind Knight path powers at the same time as a single standard action.  Any time you manifest call weaponry, you may select one other 1st level power you know; you may manifest that power using Martial Power as if it were a Path power, as long as the attack is made using the weapon summoned.  In addition, when using the Mind Knight maneuver, you gain a +%1 compteence bonus on the attack rolls.|AdvancedMindKnightPathBonus
prerequisites: PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Mind Knight Path ~ First,Mind Knight Path ~ Second
